speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand what's going on, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this fatigue and weight loss, and have you noticed any changes in your appetite or bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any night sweats, fevers, or localized pain, and have you noticed any lumps or swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin? I also need to know if you have had any recent changes in urination or difficulty swallowing.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of smoking, and have you noticed any coughing, shortness of breath, or blood in your sputum? I also need to know if you have any abdominal pain or changes in your bowel habits.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Has a history of diabetes mellitus type II, hypertension, non-seminomatous testicular cancer treated in the past, and hypercholesterolemia. Social history: Currently smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and drinks a glass of wine daily. Denies any illicit drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your significant weight loss and smoking history, I need to rule out malignancy, so I will order imaging and blood work. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: CT_Thorax_Abdomen_Pelvis REQUEST TEST: CBC REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Normal. CT_Thorax_Abdomen_Pelvis: Bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly. CBC: Elevated WBC with lymphocytosis, Normal to slightly decreased Hemoglobin, Normal to decreased Platelets. Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The imaging shows lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly, while your blood work reveals lymphocytosis. Do you have any history of jaundice, itching, or bone pain, and have you noticed any palpitations or shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: No fever, night sweats, or significant changes in bowel habits.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the lymphocytosis, generalized lymphadenopathy, and splenomegaly in an elderly male, I suspect chronic lymphocytic leukemia. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear REQUEST TEST: Flow_Cytometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Peripheral_Blood_Smear: Smudge cells present. Flow_Cytometry: Presence of monoclonal B lymphocytes with a phenotype consistent with CLL/SLL.

speaker: Doctor
text: The flow cytometry and blood smear results confirm the diagnosis of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL)
